name: Applesauce
subtitle: A playful emulator for iOS
description: Applesauce plays supported 32-bit iPhone games on modern devices. One app carrying two emulator cores, HyperHLE and touchHLE, which support different sets of games; you choose which one runs each game. An unaffiliated fork, endorsed by neither project. JIT and legally obtained decrypted 32-bit IPAs are required. Games are not included.

apps.name: Applesauce
apps.subtitle: A playful emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Plays supported 32-bit iPhone games on modern devices, carrying both the HyperHLE v1.0.6 and touchHLE 0.2.3 emulator cores so you can pick which one runs each game. An unaffiliated fork, endorsed by neither project. JIT must be enabled for each new app process. No games are included.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes games hanging at a full loading bar when a config file mixes numbers and text on one line — Peggle loads all the way now — and makes typing work in games' text fields, so Peggle's profile screen accepts a name.

Renames the app to Applesauce. Because the identifier changed, this installs alongside the old app with an empty library — move touchHLE_apps across in Files. Adds iOS 15 and 16 support through TrollStore, stops a refused rotation from killing a game, fixes a black screen after rotating, and no longer wedges the app when the emulator crashes.

apps.name: touchHLE (superseded)

apps.localizedDescription: Superseded by Applesauce from 0.4.0 onward, which is this same app renamed. Because the identifier changed, Applesauce installs separately rather than updating this one; move your touchHLE_apps folder across in Files, then delete this. There will be no further updates here.

versions.localizedDescription: Ships both emulator cores in one app and lets you choose which runs each game. Warns when JIT is off instead of closing. Replaces the 0.2.0 app; the separate touchHLE 0.1.0 app can be deleted.
Runs the HyperHLE v1.0.6 core. Fixes landscape touch input, landscape orientation and resolution scaling. Installs alongside the touchHLE build rather than replacing it.
